projects.name: Dasshu
projects.summary: Running and optimising agricultural product advertising through customer analysis, message development and seasonal planning with the sales team.
projects.overview: At Dasshu, a biological products company, I was responsible for setting up and optimising product advertising campaigns. My work combined customer and market analysis with sales team coordination to plan advertising around changing needs throughout the year.
projects.challenge: Agricultural advertising needs to reflect customer needs and seasonal timing. My work required adapting messages to market information and coordinating advertising plans with sales activities.
projects.objectives: I focused on planning advertising around customer needs and seasonal sales activities. Market analysis informed how I adjusted messages at different points in the year.
projects.strategy: I analysed customers and the market to guide advertising messages. Working with the sales team helped align communication plans with practical customer needs and seasonal sales priorities.
projects.execution:
- I set up and optimised product advertising campaigns.
- I analysed customers and the market to adapt advertising messages.
- I worked with the sales team on seasonal advertising plans.
- I supported management, team development and training within the marketing team.
projects.seoTitle: Dasshu — Agricultural Advertising | Nguyễn Hữu Huy
projects.seoDescription: My work at Dasshu covered campaign setup and optimisation, customer analysis, message development and seasonal planning with the sales team.

projects.name: VNB Global
projects.summary: Running food product advertising in the Philippines, combining customer analysis with chatbot conversation design.
projects.overview: At VNB Global, I helped set up and optimise food product advertising campaigns for the Philippine market. My responsibilities included customer and market analysis, as well as designing chatbot flow diagrams.
projects.challenge: The work required understanding customers in a market outside Vietnam and organising suitable conversation flows. I worked on advertising alongside chatbot structures for customer communication.
projects.objectives: I focused on understanding customers in the Philippines to inform food product advertising. Alongside campaign work, I designed chatbot conversation flows to support customer communication.
projects.strategy: I combined customer and market analysis with advertising implementation. For the chatbot, my role was to map and organise conversation flows for customer interactions.
projects.execution:
- I analysed customers and the Philippine market.
- I set up and optimised food product advertising campaigns.
- I designed chatbot flow diagrams and conversation flows.
projects.seoTitle: VNB Global — Advertising & Chatbots | Nguyễn Hữu Huy
projects.seoDescription: My work at VNB Global covered food product advertising in the Philippines, customer analysis and chatbot conversation design.

projects.name: MIZ Workspace
projects.summary: Designing and developing an internal marketing management system that brings together campaign data, KPIs and team performance.
projects.overview: MIZ Workspace is a project I designed and developed as Founder & Product Owner. The system aims to bring marketing management into one place, helping managers follow campaign data and team activity on a shared platform. It appears in my CV as Workspace MIZ — MKT Performance Management System.
projects.objectives: I aim to connect marketing metrics with team operations, providing a shared place to track revenue, advertising costs, customer data, closed orders and conversion rates.
projects.strategy: I designed the system around two areas: campaign data and marketing team activity. Its modules cover KPI dashboards, staff management, advertising data synchronisation and content approval workflows.
projects.execution:
- I built real-time KPI dashboards covering revenue, advertising costs, customer data, closed orders and conversion rates.
- I designed attendance tracking, work reporting and marketing staff performance evaluation.
- I integrated Meta Ads API for automatic advertising data synchronisation.
- I built KPI rankings, marketing asset management and content approval workflows.
